description.narrative: The EU grant will support the improvement of economic and social development in the province of Zambezia (target districts of the project Mocuba, Ile and Lugela), with a particular focus on creating sustainable jobs and reducing social inequalities and priority given to children, young people, women and persons with disabilities. The project does so by: 1) Empowering community social structures of women, young people and people with disabilities to operate effectively in carrying out social audits in support of the interests of their members and communities; 2) Strengthening social structures and members with the power to generate income to support their Household operations and needs (resilience building); and 3) Enhancing community-based inclusive health and education services for people with disabilities. As a long-term impact, women, young people and people with disabilities have a stronger capacity to claim and influence the provision of local public services, and are respected, valued, visible and actively involved in social and economic processes and represented in public decision-making spaces at district, provincial and national level
